# AIM Construction Management

> Florida-certified underground utility and building contractor based in Miami Lakes, FL. Commercial underground utility work (water main, sewer, force main, ductbank, horizontal directional drilling 2"–24", concrete/asphalt restoration) and residential remodeling (kitchens, bathrooms, roofing, whole-home remodels) in South Florida.

- Legal name: AIM Construction Management Inc.
- Office: 7900 Oak Lane, Suite 479, Miami Lakes, FL 33016
- Phone: (305) 331-5759
- Email: aimconstructionmgt@gmail.com
- Licenses: Florida Certified Underground Utility Contractor CUC1226535; Florida Certified Building Contractor CBC1263235
- Commercial service area: across Florida, including the Panhandle, Orlando, Tampa, Fort Myers, Palm Beach, Broward, Miami-Dade and the Florida Keys; completed projects in Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Georgia
- Commercial customers: general contractors, electrical contractors, utilities, public agencies and private customers
- Residential service area: South Florida
- Residential roofing, plumbing, HVAC and electrical work is performed by Florida-licensed trade contractors under permit

## Commercial services

- [Directional drilling (HDD)](https://aimconstructionmgt.com/services/directional-drilling): bores from 2" to 24" with company-owned Vermeer drills
- [Water main, sewer and force main](https://aimconstructionmgt.com/services/water-sewer): water main, sanitary sewer, force main, open-cut trenching, manholes and utility structures
- [Electrical and telecom ductbank](https://aimconstructionmgt.com/services/ductbank): concrete-encased ductbank, conduit, utility structures, cable pulling
- [Concrete and asphalt restoration](https://aimconstructionmgt.com/services/restoration): restoration after trenching and boring
- [All commercial services and equipment](https://aimconstructionmgt.com/services)
